literal: that which is given - envy - he who harbours - relatives - clothing even - food even - without - will perish
translation: The family of one who envies what is given to others will perish, left without even food and clothing.
modern: பிறருக்குக் கொடுக்கப்படுவதைக் கண்டு பொறாமைப்படுபவனின் சுற்றத்தார், உடுப்பதற்கு உடையும் உண்பதற்கு உணவும் இல்லாமல் அழிந்து போவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the destructive consequences of envy. If a person feels jealous when seeing others receive gifts or charity, that envy will ruin not just him but his entire family. The lengthened words 'உடுப்பதூஉம்' (even clothing) and 'உண்பதூஉம்' (even food) use a poetic device (aḷapeṭai) to emphasize the absolute destitution that will befall them, leaving them without the most basic necessities of life.
